description: This file defines a class 'HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_ImgRequired' that extends 'HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform'. The class provides a 'transform' method to supply default 'src' and 'alt' attributes to tags during HTML purification, ensuring these attributes are present and preventing the removal of the img tag due to missing alt. It manages default values based on configuration options to maintain valid and accessible image tags.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_ImgRequired
classes.description: A class that modifies image tag attributes to ensure 'src' and 'alt' are set, providing default values if missing to maintain valid and accessible HTML.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Augments the given attributes array for tags with default 'src' and 'alt' values based on configuration, preventing removal of images due to missing attributes.
